verdict.rationale: Raygun is an error and performance monitoring SaaS, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only alerting evidence covers email, Slack, Teams and PagerDuty integrations, which are chat or incident-tool notifications and do not count as webhooks. The v3 REST API is pull-based and is not an event subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
